sloka: यः स वासवनिर्जेता रावणस्यात्मसम्भवः।स एष रथमास्थाय हनुमन्तं जिघांसति ।। ६.८६.३३ ।।
transliteration: yaḥ sa vāsavanirjetā rāvaṇasyātmasambhavaḥ।sa eṣa rathamāsthāya hanumantaṁ jighāṁsati ।। 6.86.33 ।।

translations.english: "Vibheeshana told Lakshmana that Indarjith having seated is ready to attack Hanuman."
